name: My Fairy Drunkmother
source:
In Absinthiana, it is not only normal, but expected to frequently go bar-hopping in order to have any sort of social life. But when Trinity attempts to break out of her shell (again), she runs into a mischievous fairy who has some pretty skewed ideas of what would be helpful.           

How will Trinity navigate this particular situation? What are Drinkerbell's intentions? Is a "Fairy Drunkmother" even a real concept? 

[From [url=https://adairtrashart.itch.io/my-fairy-drunkmother]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在苦艾乡，频繁串酒吧不仅习以为常，更是维持正常社交生活的必备功课。然而当崔妮蒂（再一次）尝试走出自己的舒适圈时，却撞上了一只古灵精怪的小仙子——而对方对于“什么才算帮上忙”有着相当跑偏的理解。

崔妮蒂该如何应对这桩棘手的状况？“酒叮当”究竟有何企图？话说回来，“醉仙教母”这种东西真的存在吗？

[摘自[url=https://adairtrashart.itch.io/my-fairy-drunkmother]itch.io[/url]]
